home.name: Amsterdam
home.water: Inland city — not a kite spot
home.notes: Home reference only. Used to compare city wind vs the coast / IJsselmeer. Do not kite here.

spots.name: Muiderberg
spots.notes: Shallow flat water, standing depth ~300 m. Narrow grass launch next to trees — launch in the water. Gusty near the shore; S wind is offshore. Summer weed. Official zone; stay out of the swim lane and fairway. Sources: Kitegids, 35knots (52.329062, 5.113419).

spots.name: Hoorn / Schellinkhout
spots.notes: The working kite spot for the Hoorn area is Schellinkhout on the Hoornse Hop (De Laan 4), not the town beach. Hoorn-centrum is still an NKV development site, not a year-round official spot. Shallow first 500 m, short chop. Safe SE–W. Launch from the lower car park, not the dike. Summer swim zone. Sources: Kitegids, NKV, 35knots (52.633241, 5.121027).

spots.name: Zandvoort
spots.notes: West-facing beach. Official kite zones Apr 15–Oct 1 (six pole-marked zones; The Spot / WSV are the clearest). Deep water, current, summer crowds. E wind is offshore. Tide and shorebreak matter. Sources: NKV, Kitegids (52.37537, 4.5246).

spots.name: Brouwersdam South
spots.notes: NL's main kite spot. Official zone is the south / sea side only (Natural High → De Kou, yellow buoys). Low tide: 100–300 m shallow flat. High tide: shorebreak, harder for beginners. S–SE is offshore. Packed on DE holidays and Jul–Aug. GPS Brouwersdam 18, Ouddorp. Sources: Kitegids, NKV, Let's Kite (51.760158, 3.847107).

spots.name: Brouwersdam North (Grevelingen)
spots.notes: Lake side of the dam — tide-less, shallow flat water, good for freestyle/beginners. Launches are spread along the dam P-lots on the Grevelingen shore (coordinate is the mid-dam lake side, not a single official pole). S wind blows toward/along the sea side and can be offshore to the lake. Kiting rules differ from the official sea-side zone; check local signs. Some foil-only pockets nearby (e.g. De Punt: kites prohibited).

spots.name: Ouddorp
spots.notes: Wave spot on the west tip of Goeree-Overflakkee. Kiting only between beach poles 13.750–12.000; ~15 min walk from free parking Groenedijk. Currents and breakwaters. SW/W swell for waves; E/SE offshore. Sources: Kitegids (51.834538, 3.925591).

spots.name: Grevelingendam North
spots.notes: Seasonal: 15 Mar–1 Nov only (NKV / Kitegids). Stones, mussels — booties. Trees near launch. Nature reserve: stay in the kite zone. Best with E and N/NW. Sources: NKV, Kitegids (51.678675, 4.138901).

spots.name: Grevelingendam South
spots.notes: Flat shallow water, small spot. Safe W–S–SW. No kiting in front of the harbour; nature/swim area to the south is closed. Stones — booties. Opposite wind window to the north side. Source: Kitegids Strandweg 1, Bruinisse (51.676602, 4.138215).

spots.name: Neeltje Jans
spots.notes: Tide-dependent: flat/shallow at low water, waves at high water. Pier reduces current. SW is a classic go (Vrouwenpolder is then offshore). Turbulence near the turbines — stay 100 m off. Limited beach at HW. Faelweg, Vrouwenpolder. Sources: Kitegids, 35knots (51.621170, 3.680201).

spots.name: Vrouwenpolder
spots.notes: Largest Zeeland beach kite area (north beach). High-tide lagoon = beginner flat; sea side = waves. Best at flood / spring tide, 20+ kn N–NW. SW is offshore — go to Neeltje Jans instead. Official zone right of Strandrestaurant De Dam / Vertigo, yellow buoys. Fort den Haakweg. Source: Kitegids (51.590696, 3.627504).

spots.name: Roompot / Kamperland
spots.notes: Roompot X-Beach, Kamperland. Flat Oosterschelde water. Best NW–NE (about 270–45°). S/SW/SE/E offshore. Oysters — booties. Tight launch at high water + north wind. Year-round. Source: Kitegids (51.592073, 3.728973).

spots.name: Domburg
spots.notes: Biggest Zeeland beach waves, strong current, pole rows in the water. Expert only. Check dike works. Seasonal downwinder ban toward Oostkapelle/Vrouwenpolder 09:00–19:00. Sources: Kitegids (51.565912, 3.491281).

spots.name: Cadzand (Vlamingpolder)
spots.notes: Belgian-border wave spot, north of Moio Beach. Sharp mussel piers, poles, current — go upwind immediately. Best N–SW. Vlamingpolder often Mar–Oct. Het Zwin (51.3729, 3.3690) is a nearby west variant. Sources: Kitegids, 35knots (51.375526, 3.380568).

omitted.name: Schelphoek / Kattendijke / Wemeldinge
omitted.reason: Place names on the Oosterschelde map, not designated kite zones. Kitesurfing in the Oosterschelde Natura 2000 area is only allowed in official zones (e.g. Roompot, Ouwerkerk seasonal). Schelphoek-West is a closed nature unit. Not listed as spots on Kitegids or NKV.

omitted.name: Krabbendijke (Roelshoek)
omitted.reason: Former Oosterschelde spot — permanently closed (power lines). Not included.

omitted.name: Hoorn town beach (Het Park)
omitted.reason: NKV development site only; not an official year-round kite spot. Use Schellinkhout.
